verdict.rationale: The evidence says Gitea has an API, but nothing documents a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found HTTP 404 at every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.gitea.com. Having an API, an SDK or a CLI is an adjacent capability and does not count as a published spec. Confidence is medium because the probe only checked the docs domain, not a running instance's API paths.
